dataset_info_keypoints: access the 17 COCO-format human keypoint definitions with names, IDs, colors, and swap pairs
dataset_info_skeleton: access the 19 skeleton bone links connecting keypoints for human pose visualization
dataset_info_joint_weights: access the per-joint weighting factors used for pose estimation loss computation
dataset_info_sigmas: access the per-joint sigma values used for OKS (Object Keypoint Similarity) evaluation
dataset_info_paper: access the OCHuman dataset paper metadata including authors, title, and homepage
